goal: Furnished redesign concept of the owner's living room (geosil), seen from the window-wall photo, blending warm Japandi calm with a rich New York apartment feel, for private design planning.
facts: Room is about 4.15 m wide and 3.35 m deep.
Full-height black-framed window wall with roller blinds and a forest and mountain view.
Large-format white marble-look porcelain tile floor and a matching marble-look feature wall on the right.
Flat white ceiling with recessed downlights, a ceiling cassette air conditioner, and access panels.
locks: Do not change the architecture: walls, wall positions, ceiling shape, window frames and mullions, glass, roller blinds, and the view outside stay exactly as photographed.
Keep the existing marble-look floor tile and the marble-look feature wall, including their color and veining.
Keep every ceiling fixture: downlights, air conditioner cassette, access panels, sprinkler and sensor.
Keep the wall sockets and switch plates in place.
Keep the same camera position, lens, perspective, and framing as the photo.
freedoms: Add movable furniture, a rug, lamps, plants, art, books, and soft decor only.
Remove the white floor navigation circles and the small green dot, which are virtual-tour overlays, not part of the room.

direction.thesis: Japandi restraint warmed by a collected New York apartment richness.
direction.signature: A low, deep oak-and-boucle sofa facing the forest view, grounded by a large wool rug in warm camel and charcoal, with one oversized framed artwork and a brass arc floor lamp.
direction.avoid: Sterile showroom staging, clutter, and generic gray modern furniture.

composition: Seating group centered in front of the window wall, low enough to keep the view open.
Leave the floor-to-window line visible so the room still reads as spacious.
Scale every piece to a 4.15 m by 3.35 m room; nothing oversized.
rendering: Photorealistic interior photograph, soft overcast daylight from the windows, warm 2700K accent lamps.
Palette: light oak, walnut, cream boucle, camel leather, charcoal wool, aged brass, deep olive greenery.
Natural textures: linen, wool, matte ceramic, ribbed wood.

instructions: No visible text, logos, or watermarks.

references.purpose: preserve room geometry, windows, floor, walls, and ceiling

authority.intended_use: Private interior design concept for the user's own living room.

delivery_notes: Viewed on screen for planning furniture choices.

review_tests: Window frames, mullions, blinds, ceiling fixtures, sockets, floor tile, and marble wall match the source photo.
Camera angle and room proportions are unchanged.
Furniture is plausibly scaled for a 4.15 m by 3.35 m room and does not block the windows.
Navigation circles and the green dot are gone.
The style reads as Japandi warmth plus New York richness, not a generic showroom.
